qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | deputy director (engineering): Officers under the Central Government or State Government or Union Territory Administrations or Major Ports or public sector undertakings, or autonomous bodies or universities or recognized research organizations possessing: (a)(i) holding analogous post on regular basis in parent cadre or department; or (ii) with 5 years service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in Level-10 (Rs. 56,100 - 1,77,500) in the pay matrix or equivalent in parent cadre or department; and (b) possessing Bachelor's degree in Civil/Mechanical Engineering from a recognized University or Institute; and (c) 5 years experience in the field of: (i) Design, construction and maintenance of Civil Engineering works including Harbour Engineering; or (ii) Maintenance and operation of different types of cranes, diesel locos, marine engines, winches and auxiliary machinery in a mechanical or marine workshop or organisation.

salary_details.details: The period of deputation including short-term contract in another ex-cadre post held immediately prior to this appointment in the same or any other organisation or department of the Central Government shall ordinarily not exceed three years.

how_to_apply: Download the vacancy circular and application format from the official website at https://shipmin.gov.in/.
Fill out the Bio-data / Curriculum Vitae form accurately in all respects.
Ensure the application is duly signed by the applicant and certified by the Head of Office or Employer.
Gather two copies of the signed Bio-data along with complete and up-to-date ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years attested by an officer not below the level of Under Secretary.

Enclose vigilance clearance certificate, cadre clearance, certificate of immediate relieving upon selection, certificate of no major/minor penalties during the last 10 years, and integrity certificate.

Send the complete application "Through proper channel" to the designated address: Under Secretary (Admn.), Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, Room No. 439, Transport Bhawan, 1- Parliament Street, New Delhi-110001.
Ensure the application reaches the specified address within 60 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar.
important_instructions: Candidates applying for the post will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently. Incomplete applications, applications received after the closing date, or applications not received through proper channel will be summarily rejected. The cut-off date for determining eligibility will be the last date for receipt of nominations in the Ministry (60th day from the publication date in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar). Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion are not eligible for deputation consideration, and deputationists are not eligible for promotion. Officers already on deputation must have their applications forwarded by their parent cadre/department along with required clearances.

faq.question: Q1. What is MoPSW Deputy Director Engineering Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways to fill one post of Deputy Director (Engineering) in Pay Level-11 on a deputation (including short-term contract) basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Deputy Director (Engineering).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MoPSW Deputy Director recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 23-11-2026, which is 60 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree in Civil or Mechanical Engineering from a recognized university or institute, along with relevant service or experience requirements as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation or short-term contract is 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline through proper channel along with required certificates and documents to the Under Secretary (Admn.), Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for the Deputy Director (Engineering) post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary in Pay Level-11 (Rs. 67,700 - 2,08,700) as per the 7th CPC.
